notes: {"answer":"Call 911 now. Your child is floppy and drowsy after a seizure with fever, and that needs emergency care. Lay them on their side on a safe surface, put nothing in their mouth, and stay with them. Tell the dispatcher the seizure lasted about 1 minute.","triage":"Call 911 now and do not wait to see if they perk up. Go to the ER by ambulance. Tell 911 right away if they turn blue, struggle to breathe, or seize again. 811 is for nurse advice later, not for this."}
